alignment: boundary comparison across a date gap: the official injury-report index listed no 11/18 revisions at the check (2026-11-19T07:00Z), so the 11/17 11:15 AM ET file of record is compared against the 11/19 12:00 a.m. ET revision directly. The reports cover different slates (11/17-11/18 vs 11/19-11/20), so no row aligns; nothing is inferred across the gap

rule: A boundary diff compares two dated revisions that are not consecutive revisions of the same slate. It reports the row counts and the alignment result only; it never claims a status change across the gap and never fills the missing revisions.
